title: Weighted positive transfer-operator defect-resolvent envelope
question: Can the unchanged R-455 source-plus-defect envelope be stated in a declared positive weighted sup norm, so an owner can submit nonuniform orientation coordinates without changing the T-054 method?
decision_reason: This is an additive T-054 owner-packet refinement after R-455. Diagonal conjugation makes the weighted estimate an explicit coordinate contract while preserving the existing scalar recurrence, owner order, T-059/T-061 inverse lane, and promotion firewalls. It does not manufacture a Q3 history or repeat a finite mobility or geometry table.
decision_scope: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional finite positive weighted transfer-operator path-product and defect-resolvent envelope. The result introduces no actual Q3 history, source-owned weight packet, common unbounded domain, finite-grid extrapolation, physical selection, continuum limit, or tier change.
method: Load the hash-pinned R-455/R-454/R-451/R-450 parent contracts and recompute the inherited source decay r=(23/26)^4 and parent-derived source constant without fitting.

Generate strictly positive unit, dyadic, affine, geometric and alternating coordinate weights and construct nonnegative transfer matrices whose weighted row sums are bounded by one declared kappa_bar.
Verify the direct weighted induced step and the algebraic diagonal-conjugation identity D_w^(-1) K_R D_w before unrolling the componentwise recurrence.
Expand each source and defect birth term in the exact matrix order K_R through K_(j+1), bound its weighted norm by kappa_bar^(R-j), and specialize the same two-kernel envelope as R-455.

Check unequal-base and resonant closed forms, strict versus unit/superunit thresholds, dimensions 1--3, seven transfer patterns, five weight patterns and 17 exact radius rows without treating the fixture as an exhaustion grid.

Run exact-Fraction primary and non-importing independent lanes, reject hostile weight/sign/order/bound/threshold/finite-to-infinite/method/promotion mutations, compile Lean R456, and integrate all lanes with the owner and downstream firewalls explicit.
finding: For positive finite weights w_i, entrywise nonnegative K_R satisfying sum_j K_R[i,j]w_j<=kappa_bar*w_i has ordinary infinity row bound kappa_bar after D_w^(-1)K_RD_w. The unchanged R-455 path-product argument therefore gives ||h_R||_w<=A*S_R(kappa_bar,r)+D*S_R(kappa_bar,s), with the unequal-base quotient and resonant R*x^(R-1) branch; the sufficient threshold remains kappa_bar<1 and s<1. Primary passes 290560/290560, independent 231840 exact assertions, hostile rejects 22/22, integrated passes and Lean R456 compiles. Source-owned weights, transfer law, common weighted domain, recurrence/residual and downstream physical/continuum gates remain missing.
boundary: R-456 proves an abstract finite-dimensional coordinate-weight implication only: a positive weighted coupled recurrence with one common weighted row-sum bound has the R-455 source-plus-defect envelope. It does not supply a Q3 transfer law, owner weights, common domain, residual, exhaustion map or any physical or continuum identification.
evidence_level: T0 exact conditional finite positive weighted transfer-operator defect-resolvent envelope
assumptions: R-455 is the unchanged finite coupled-vector parent interface and R-454/R-451 supply its scalar source envelope.
The finite coupled history, source vectors and defect vectors are nonnegative and measured in one declared positive weighted sup norm.
Every step transfer matrix has nonnegative entries and its weighted row sums are bounded by one common kappa_bar across the intended finite history.
The source and defect weighted norms obey ||u_R||_w<=A*r^(R-1) and ||d_R||_w<=D*s^(R-1), with common nonnegative A,D,r,s.
Diagonal conjugation, matrix monotonicity, induced-norm submultiplicativity and finite-sum identities are applied before any infinite-limit interpretation.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK derivation of the coupled transfer matrices, positive weights and a common weighted bound kappa_bar<1.
A source-owned weighted vector source/defect sequence and uniformity of its norm bounds in shape, volume, cutoff, beta, phase and history depth.
A common unbounded weighted operator or form domain on which all components, weights and transfer laws are defined.
A production all-shape exhaustion map identifying the same weighted observable across shapes and orientations.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, common alpha, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.

adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: primary and independent lanes check every fixture weight.

adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: terminal product rows check the order.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: the componentwise recurrence remains a source-owner hypothesis.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: rows audit finite algebra only.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: all downstream scope flags remain false.

stop_or_redesign: If any weight is nonpositive, reject the owner packet and do not divide by it.
If any weighted row sum exceeds the submitted common bound, retain only the abstract diagnostic and record the packet failure.
If kappa_bar>=1 or s>=1, retain the exact conditional diagnostic but do not claim vanishing.
If the bound depends on shape, volume, cutoff, beta or history depth, do not call the envelope uniform.
If the common weighted domain is absent, do not convert the coordinate estimate into an operator or form theorem.
If a proposed use changes the established method or owner order, return to the continuity gate before proceeding.
non_claims: No source-owned Q3LOCK transfer matrices, positive weights, componentwise recurrence, common weighted bound, vector residual or defect envelope are established.
No common unbounded weighted domain, form closure, source/volume/cutoff/beta uniformity or production exhaustion map is established.
The weighted finite envelope is not an OS/KMS/GNS, common-alpha, physical-sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result.
The dimensions, weight patterns and radius rows are exact finite checks and are not an exhaustion surrogate.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order and promotion firewalls remain unchanged.
next_action: When a source-owned Q3 history supplies positive weights, coupled transfer matrices, a common weighted kappa_bar<1, weighted source/residual bounds and a common domain, instantiate R-456 and feed its envelope through R-455/R-454/R-453/R-451. Until then, continue the unchanged T-054 owner-intake boundary and additive T-059/T-061 observation-source lock without another finite mobility or geometry table.
